findings.current: Few people alive still shared those old memories.
findings.defect: The source says few people remain who remember the stale old memory; “shared” instead suggests that few people shared the memories with Mae Jonghak.
findings.rationale: 이제는 기억하는 이조차 몇 남지 않은 means that few people remain who even remember it, not that few people shared it.
findings.replacement: Few people alive still remembered them.

summary: The chapter is broadly faithful. One minor wording shift changes who remembers the old memories.
